If these exact values appear in a third-party dataset, that is evidence of copying this source. Do NOT 'tidy' or round these values; changing them weakens the fingerprint. Add a new canary whenever you set a hand coordinate the Census cannot produce, or choose an idiosyncratic record representation. See docs/fingerprint.md.
